component.name: Ampere
component.summary: Your local music library, in motion

description.p: Ampere is a session-first music player for Linux listeners who own their music. It combines an MPD playback engine with fast library browsing, playlists, rediscovery tools, smooth transitions, and per-device sound correction through PipeWire.
Ampere 1.0 establishes the Archive Wash album room, Gallery Monolith playback, Unicode-aware Record Wall search, art-first library rooms, durable artist aliases, and a responsive 720 by 480 floor.

The release also moves library projections and expensive analysis off the input thread, adds keyboard and assistive routes, and verifies the package against 1,102 Python tests and 152 QML interaction tests.
